title: UV photolysis of peroxynitrite on micropollutant degradation: implications of oxidative capacity for potable reuse treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00997A, Communication
Liang Wu, Sitao Liu, Haizhou Liu
In membrane-UV potable reuse, dichloramine (NHCl2) hydrolysis forms peroxynitrite (ONOO−) in RO permeate. UV photolysis of ONOO− generates hydroxyl radicals, enabling rapid micropollutant degradation and enhancing UV/AOP treatment performance.
